name: aspirin
document: Aspirin is a salicylate that irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase. It is used for pain, fever and inflammation, and at low dose for cardiovascular prophylaxis. Long text follows to force more than one chunk.

name: PTGS2
document: PTGS2 encodes cyclooxygenase-2, an enzyme induced during inflammation.

name: PTGS1
document: PTGS1 encodes cyclooxygenase-1, expressed constitutively in most tissues.

name: inflammation
document: Inflammation is a protective response involving immune cells and mediators.

name: ibuprofen
document: Ibuprofen is a nonselective NSAID inhibiting cyclooxygenase enzymes reversibly.

name: celecoxib
document: Celecoxib is a selective COX-2 inhibitor used in arthritis.

name: prostaglandin synthesis
document: The prostaglandin synthesis pathway converts arachidonic acid to prostaglandins.

name: arthritis
document: Arthritis is joint inflammation causing pain and stiffness.

name: TNF
document: TNF encodes tumour necrosis factor, a pro-inflammatory cytokine.

name: paracetamol
document: Paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic with weak anti-inflammatory action.

name: cytokine signalling
document: Cytokine signalling coordinates immune cell communication.

name: fever
document: Fever is an elevated body temperature, often mediated by prostaglandins.
